title: 3D Game Artist
summary: 3D game artists build the props, environments and characters players see, from modelling and sculpting to textures that are ready for the game engine. They sit in a studio art team under an art lead, working with game designers and developers to keep assets within performance budgets.
dailyDuties: Model props or environment pieces from concept art and references
Sculpt high poly detail and bake it to game meshes
Texture assets with PBR materials in Substance Painter
Unwrap UVs and build LODs within poly budgets
Import assets into the engine and set up materials
Fix assets after art lead reviews

skills.expectation: Model game props, environments or characters in Maya, 3ds Max or Blender
Sculpt high poly detail in ZBrush and bake it to game meshes
Texture assets with a PBR workflow in Substance Painter or Designer
Retopologise, unwrap UVs and build LODs within poly and texture budgets
Import assets into the team's engine and set up materials and collision
Import assets into the team's engine and set up materials and collision
Paint textures, decals and reference boards in Photoshop
Take feedback in art reviews and follow the art lead's style guide
Dress environments and work with level designers on blockouts
Check assets in and out with version control such as Perforce or Git
Prepare light assets for AR or VR projects

groups.label: A game engine (Unity or Unreal Engine)
